description:
Rust's player count: live on Steam, every monthly peak since 2013, by region. The data behind https://rust.wiki/player-count. `live` is Steam's own count of everyone running Rust at the last
check (`updated_at`); `months` is every monthly peak since 2013 as [YYYY-MM, peak] (from SteamCharts' public record
of Steam's numbers); `record` the all-time monthly peak; `years` each year's peak; `this_month` and
`same_month_last_year` for comparison; `breakdown` / `regions` split the players on the servers rust.wiki polls by
region and server type (null when the server poll has nothing). Server players are always fewer than Steam's figure:
Steam also counts menus, queues and untracked servers.
name: get_player_count
title: Rust's player count: live on Steam, every monthly peak since 2013, by region
